projects.title: KCET EduGuide-Personalized Rank-to-College Advisor
description: Developed KCET EduGuide, a full-stack counselling platform used by 70+ students, that helps students to prepare KCET counselling choice lists through personalized rank-based recommendations and automated choice management.

Built frontend using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and with responsive UI, interactive cutoff visualizations with Recharts, PDF choice list generation, JWT-based authentication, and advanced filtering for colleges, branches, categories, locations, and counselling rounds.

Developed a Node.js and Express backend with MongoDB, implementing recommendation algorithms, secure JWT authentication, mentor verification, meeting management, and RESTful APIs for real-time data access.
Deployed the application using Amazon EC2 for the backend, Vercel for the frontend, and Amazon S3 for hosting images and branch insight JSON files.
features: Personalized college and branch recommendations based on KCET rank, reservation category, and preferred locations
Interactive counselling choice list builder with drag-and-drop reordering, bulk actions, PDF export, and mock allotment prediction
Advanced search and filtering by category, counselling round, year, cluster, location, and rank range with historical cutoff trend visualization
College and branch explorer with verified student reviews, branch insights, career information, and placement details
Peer-to-peer mentoring platform with verified student mentors, Jitsi Meet integration, and admin-approved webinars
OCR-based student ID verification and admin approval workflow for mentor authentication
Role-based authentication using JWT with secure access control, persistent sessions, and profile management
Cloud-native deployment using Amazon EC2, Vercel, MongoDB Atlas, and Amazon S3 for storing images and branch insight JSON files

projects.title: Topic-Based Micro-Subscription Learning Platform
description: Developed a topic-based micro-subscription learning platform enabling users to purchase individual topics instead of full courses, providing a flexible and cost-effective learning experience.

Built a full-stack application using Django REST Framework and React + TypeScript with JWT authentication, integrating wallet-based payments, atomic transactions, and MinIO-based storage for markdown content and videos.

Implemented role-based access control, real-time discussion using WebSockets, problem contribution and admin verification system with reward mechanism, and progress tracking with a professional dashboard UI.
Designed a comprehensive admin dashboard for managing courses, topics, problems, subscriptions, and analytics, ensuring efficient platform administration and user engagement.
features: Topic-based learning platform with pay-per-topic subscriptions instead of full-course purchases
Premium content access control with subscription-based topic, problem, and discussion unlocking
Real-time topic discussions using Django Channels and WebSocket integration
Role-based authentication with JWT, secure wallet PIN, and admin/student access control
Interactive coding problems and practice management with progress tracking
Digital wallet system for purchasing topics and managing student credits
Comprehensive admin dashboard for managing courses, topics, problems, subscriptions, and analytics
Responsive full-stack application built with Django REST Framework, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, and MySQL

projects.title: Water Monitoring System
description: Developed a Water Monitoring System leveraging IoT technologies to optimize water usage and mitigate wastage, using Raspberry Pi, water flow sensors, and Twilio.
It sends instant alerts via Twilio's communication API to notify users about abnormal water usage or potential issues.
The project integrates Python-based visualization tools and the ThingSpeak platform to provide actionable insights and track water consumption trends.
features: Real-time water flow measurement and monitoring
Automatic alerts for abnormal or excess water usage
Data logging and visualization on ThingSpeak platform
Web interface built with Django for monitoring and reports
Email and SMS notifications using Twilio and Smtplib
